changes.comment: Adds a per-connection message allowance, defaulting to 200 per second. A command like REQUEST_STATE costs the store a full serialization and the hub a fan-out, so a client looping on it turned one cheap socket write into repeated work across every connected process. The excess is dropped rather than the socket closed: severing would punish a brief burst exactly like a flood, and a panel that overshoots recovers on the next window.
